desktop-workspace.title: Project folder
desktop-workspace.help: Choose a folder on this computer, then confirm its binding to the current project.
desktop-workspace.replace_help: Bind a different folder after saving and confirming any open changes.
desktop-workspace.project: Bind only to the current project
desktop-workspace.operation_confirmed: The original binding operation is confirmed. Refreshing the current project binding does not repeat that operation.
desktop-workspace.current_changed: The original operation is confirmed. The workspace now reflects the current project binding.
desktop-workspace.unknown: The original binding result is unconfirmed. Check it before choosing another folder or leaving this page. Recovery is kept in this open application only.
desktop-workspace.conflict: The project binding changed. Refresh its current state, then choose the folder again. This selection keeps its original binding reference.
desktop-workspace.refreshed: Current binding refreshed. Choose the folder again before binding.
desktop-workspace.expired: This folder selection expired. Choose the folder again before binding.
desktop-workspace.selection_failed: The folder was not selected or its authorization could not be verified. Choose it again in the desktop app.
desktop-workspace.selection_unavailable: A new binding cannot start while an original binding still needs checking.
desktop-workspace.binding_failed: The folder was not bound. Check your current access and choose the folder again.
desktop-workspace.refresh_failed: The current binding could not be refreshed. Try refreshing again before choosing a folder.
desktop-workspace.disabled: Save and confirm your open changes before changing the project folder.
